questions.question_text: Jo indriyonī vṛuttione strīādiknā viṣhaymā pravartāve chhe to enu antaḥkaraṇ ______ thāy chhe ane kalyāṇnā mārg thakī ______ jāy chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Pr.8, 'Jo indriyonī vṛuttione strīādiknā viṣhaymā pravartāve chhe to enu antaḥkaraṇ bhraṣhṭ thāy chhe ane kalyāṇnā mārg thakī paḍī jāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Haribhaktane to jeṭlī kasar rahe chhe teṭlī ______ karīne rahe chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Pr.20, 'Haribhaktane to jeṭlī kasar rahe chhe teṭlī potāne āḷase karīne rahe chhe.'

questions.question_text: Je shraddhāvān puruṣh hoy ane tene jo sāchā santno sang maḷe ane te santnā vachanne viṣhe shraddhāvān thāy, to enā hṛudayne viṣhe ______ ādik je kalyāṇkārī guṇ te sarve prakaṭ thaī āve chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Sā.18, 'Je shraddhāvān puruṣh hoy ane tene jo sāchā santno sang maḷe ane te santnā vachanne viṣhe shraddhāvān thāy, to enā hṛudayne viṣhe svadharma, vairāgya, vivek, gnān, bhakti ādik je kalyāṇkārī guṇ te sarve prakaṭ thaī āve chhe.'

questions.question_text: Sangno bhed em chhe je, so janme ekāntik thavāno hoy te āj thāy ane ā janme ekāntik thavāno hoy tene paṇ so janma dharvā paḍe; e be ______ chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.4/124, 'Sangno bhed em chhe je, so janme ekāntik thavāno hoy te āj thāy ane ā janme ekāntik thavāno hoy tene paṇ so janma dharvā paḍe; e be bhed chhe.'

questions.question_text: Amārī sevā kartā hoy ne tenā hṛudaymā jo ______ bhakti na hoy to te upar het karīe toy paṇ na thāy.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Pr.37, 'Amārī sevā kartā hoy ne tenā hṛudaymā jo parameshwarnī bhakti na hoy to te upar het karīe toy paṇ na thāy.'

questions.question_text: Satsangmā kusangno jog thāy ne brahmarūp hoy to ______ karī nākhe ne satsangmā sārāno jog thāy to dehrūp hoy tene ______ kare.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.5/311, 'Satsangmā kusangno jog thāy ne brahmarūp hoy to dehrūp karī nākhe ne satsangmā sārāno jog thāy to dehrūp hoy tene brahmarūp kare.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwān tathā bhagwānnā bhakta teno jene avaguṇ āvyo hoy ne te satsangī kahevāto hoy to paṇ tene ______ jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.An.12, 'Bhagwān tathā bhagwānnā bhakta teno jene avaguṇ āvyo hoy ne te satsangī kahevāto hoy to paṇ tene haḍkāyā shvān jevo jāṇvo.'

questions.question_text: Evo je hoy tene ______ kahīe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Lo.1, 'Jene potāne nishchay karāvyo hoy ne te ja vaḷī em kahe je e Bhagwān nathī tyāre ene em jāṇe je ‘enu māthu faryu chhe.’ Evo je hoy tene uttam gnānvāḷo kahīe.'

questions.question_text: Baḷiyā bhagwānnā bhakta hoy teno sang karīe to ______ āve.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/177, 'Baḷiyā bhagwānnā bhakta hoy teno sang karīe to jīvmā baḷ āve.'

questions.question_text: Mārā vā'lājī shu vā'lap dīse re, teno sang shīd ______, Te vinā kene ______ re... ṭek
questions.explanation: As per Muktanand Swami Kirtan, 'Mārā vā'lājī shu vā'lap dīse re, teno sang shīd tajīe, Te vinā kene bhajīe re... ṭek'

questions.question_text: Sanmukh thātā shankā na kīje, mar bhālā taṇā ______ varase re.
questions.explanation: As per Muktanand Swami Kirtan, 'Sanmukh thātā shankā na kīje, mar bhālā taṇā meh varase re.'

questions.question_text: Shūḷī upar shayan karāve toy, sādhune ______ rahīe re; Durijan lok durbhāṣhaṇ bole, tenu ______ sarve sahīe re.
questions.explanation: As per Muktanand Swami Kirtan, 'Shūḷī upar shayan karāve toy, sādhune sange rahīe re; Durijan lok durbhāṣhaṇ bole, tenu sukhduḥkh sarve sahīe re.'

questions.question_text: Te Akṣharnā be swarūp chhe - ek to nirākār ekras chaitanya chhe tene ______ kahīe, ______ kahīe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Pr.21, 'Te Akṣharnā be swarūp chhe - ek to nirākār ekras chaitanya chhe tene Chidākāsh kahīe, Brahmamahol kahīe.'

questions.question_text: Māṭe potānā iṣhṭadevnā je janmathī karīne deh mūkavā paryant charitra tenu je shāstra teṇe karīne sampradāynī ______ thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Ma.58, 'Māṭe potānā iṣhṭadevnā je janmathī karīne deh mūkavā paryant charitra tenu je shāstra teṇe karīne sampradāynī puṣhṭi thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Vachanāmṛut kartā bījāmā māl manāy chhe e ______ jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.4/132, 'Vachanāmṛut kartā bījāmā māl manāy chhe e moh jāṇvo.'

questions.question_text: Ā vātomānthī to brahmarūp thavāshe bāḷ, joban ane vṛuddha e traṇ prakārnī strīo, kacharo ane kanchan e badhu ______ jashe.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/33, 'Ā vātomānthī to brahmarūp thavāshe bāḷ, joban ane vṛuddha e traṇ prakārnī strīo, kacharo ane kanchan e badhu sarkhu thaī jashe.'

questions.question_text: Ā vātne ame karīe chhīe te kāī buddhinī kalpanāe nathī kartā tathā siddhāī jaṇāvvā sāru nathī kartā; ā to amārī ______ vāt chhe ne jem ame vartīe chhīe tem vāt karīe chhīe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.An.39, 'Ā vātne ame karīe chhīe te kāī buddhinī kalpanāe nathī kartā tathā siddhāī jaṇāvvā sāru nathī kartā; ā to amārī ajmāvel vāt chhe ne jem ame vartīe chhīe tem vāt karīe chhīe.'

questions.question_text: Vishvās rākhīne prītie sahit je bhagwān puruṣhottam nārāyaṇnī vāt sāmbhaḷvī ethī bīju manne ______ ne ______ koī moṭu sādhan nathī.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ka.12, 'Vishvās rākhīne prītie sahit je bhagwān puruṣhottam nārāyaṇnī vāt sāmbhaḷvī ethī bīju manne sthir thavānu ne nirviṣhayī thavānu koī moṭu sādhan nathī.'

questions.question_text: To bhagwānnī kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷyāmā jene jeṭlī prīti tene teṭlo ______ abhāv thāy tathā ______ doṣhno nāsh thāy.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.An.24, 'To bhagwānnī kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷyāmā jene jeṭlī prīti tene teṭlo jagatno abhāv thāy tathā kām, krodh, lobhādik doṣhno nāsh thāy.'

questions.question_text: Te shu je, ______, ______, ______ e sarvene māthe līṭā tāṇīe chhīe paṇ navrā beṭhā chhīe em na samajvu.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/50, 'Te shu je, jamapurī, chorāsī, garbhvās e sarvene māthe līṭā tāṇīe chhīe paṇ navrā beṭhā chhīe em na samajvu.'
